# Public product screenshots

The `*-live.png` files are optimized, sanitized browser captures from the current TropaTT demo. Before saving, the capture workflow replaced user-controlled text with neutral sample labels, removed record links and form values, and hid avatars, uploaded images, and other potentially identifying media. They are intended for GitHub rendering and contain no customer or production data.

The SVG files in this directory are fictional UI mockups. They are retained as lightweight fallback assets and are not browser captures.

The installer PNG was captured from an isolated local copy of the application with no `.env` or installation lock. The already-installed public demo intentionally returns HTTP 410 from its installer endpoint.
